rule: No mystique without a row. Reality is the referee.

forecasts.claim: Elon 2011: SpaceX has Boeing, Lockheed, Ariane, Proton/Soyuz near checkmate in rocket technology.
Elon 2011: Endgame is China — the remaining industrial peer.
At least two independent Chinese operators each log five or more successful orbital booster recoveries.
At least one Chinese orbital booster is reflown (true reuse, not only recovered).
Combined Chinese orbital launch cadence remains below SpaceX cadence.
Starship logs 50+ orbital flights in a calendar year before any Chinese vehicle does.
No engineering-grade psychohistory exists as a discipline by 2030.
A major US or allied space-industrial strategy names Southern Hemisphere recovery or feedstock as a gap.
Falcon-class is the global default for medium-lift; the other league is Starship-class or empty.
